notes:
Manafall 0.1.33 - Windows client

What's new in 0.1.33
- Koosh plants are a normal bush size again. Aim at one and press F to harvest a Koosh Cap.
- Online -> Host: the middle field shows Max players next to the number (not a bare unlabeled value).
- Crystals now scatter in the world like stones, about half as often. Snow biomes have a bit more (~20%).
- Building fire: rain soaks fires over time (with a short grace after ignition) so storm fires don't die instantly; fire spells can ignite wood buildings (chance scales with fire damage). Debug: F6 clear weather, F7 extinguish, F8 ignite nearest wood.

Still true from recent patches
- Online -> Host opens server options instead of bouncing to the main menu.
- Harvest, hit markers, and loot feel more reliable on clients.
- Host and clients share the same day/night clock.
- Gradual dusk colors; visible sun, moon, and stars; occasional northern lights.

Patcher
- Keeps a partial download; only installs a full matching client zip.
- Auto-update downloads three parts. Leave ~4 GB free on your Windows drive.
